_comment: Hand-maintained FanDuel-name -> FantasyPros-name overrides for players the
automatic match tiers cannot reach. Confirm a pair ONCE by eye, add it here,
and it is permanent. Keys and values are matched after normalization, so
punctuation, case and generational suffixes do not matter.
Do NOT add a pair to silence a warning you have not verified: a wrong alias
hands one player another player's projection, which is invisible, whereas an
unmatched player simply drops out of the pool.
